title: Preserve executable permissions in Core fast-release staging
goal: Make the native fast-release pipeline execute its staged Linux binaries after atomic staging while preserving their exact bytes and digest.

results.root_cause: Atomic staging used fs::write, which created the Unix destination with mode 0644 and made the subsequent smoke execution fail with Permission denied.
results.change: The staged destination now restores executable permissions on Unix for both newly written and already-identical files; Windows behavior is unchanged. A Unix regression test covers the mode repair.
results.boundary: Core workflow tooling only; no product source, release record, dependency, Windows, Jan artifact or credential change.
